controls.name: C-21d
controls.query:
FROM logs-zeek.connection-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-06-29T00:00:00.000Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-06T20:30:00.000Z"
        AND destination.port == 5432
        AND source.ip == "172.18.0.21"
        AND destination.ip == "172.18.0.12"
| STATS count = COUNT(*), first_seen = MIN(@timestamp), last_seen = MAX(@timestamp), total_bytes = SUM(destination.bytes) BY source.ip, destination.ip, destination.port
| SORT count DESC
